meta.title: Heartprint · Persona & Emotion Memory
meta.description: A memory that fades like a person's: recent days stay vivid, older memories compress, featureless trivia becomes a one-line gist after 90 days, merges after half a year and is deleted after a year, while personality and emotional nodes endure. Painful facts remain, but the painful feelings fade by a forced rule. Maintains memory documents plus a local backup; auto-delivers the first companion document after 3 months, then one every month, and keeps the delivered file updated.
